statement.p: The set B = \left\lbrace \left[\begin{array}{cc} -1 \amp 3\cr 0 \amp 0 \end{array}\right], \left[\begin{array}{cc} 0 \amp 1\cr 0 \amp 3 \end{array}\right], \left[\begin{array}{cc} 0 \amp 0\cr 0 \amp 2 \end{array}\right] \right\rbrace is a basis of the space of upper-triangular 2\times 2 matrices.
Find the coordinates of M = \left[\begin{array}{cc} 3 \amp 7\cr 0 \amp 2 \end{array}\right] with respect to this basis.
